entities.summary: Albert Wilson II is an American former professional football wide receiver who played in the National Football League (NFL) for the Kansas City Chiefs and Miami Dolphins. He played college football for the Georgia State Panthers. He holds several Georgia State records, including most touchdown receptions, longest pass play, and longest punt return.
